title: Battle of Mohács
summary: On 29 August 1526 an Ottoman army under Sultan Süleyman defeated Hungary's army, led by King Louis II, on a marshy plain at Mohács on the Danube. Louis was killed, and the defeat ended Hungary as an independent united kingdom; much of it was later absorbed into the Ottoman Empire.

uncertainty.note: Day given by Britannica; the park directorate gives only August 1526.

where.modern_name: Mohács National Memorial site, Sátorhely, Mohács, Hungary
where.historical_name: Plain near Mohács, Kingdom of Hungary

importance.justification: Decisive defeat that ended Hungary as an independent united kingdom and opened Ottoman rule over much of it.

reviewer_note: Pin is the memorial site at Sátorhely (a proxy for the battlefield, whose exact extent I did not verify). Britannica gives two versions of Louis's death; summary says only killed.
author: historian-agent:claude-api-sonnet-5-5
